name: dsh-seam
description: Managed seam-toolchain payload (engine + standard specs + upstream-follow scripts) for DSH plugin repos: consumer-side seam discovery/verification, syncable via `dsh-seam sync`

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('payload/scripts', 'dist-test/scripts', { recursive: true }); cpSync('package.json', 'dist-test/package.json')" && node --test dist-test/tests/mechanism/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
